confounds: Learning and forgetting between the decision and the first review: a miss can mean the learner forgot, a pass can mean they learned the topic elsewhere in the meantime.

Learner-requested practice and follow-up lanes in that window can show the LO's items before its scheduled check: early clean answers are recorded as early practice and never pass the check, but an early miss the diagnosis attributes to a knowledge gap returns the LO to learning (resolved early).

Diagnoser error: the first review and lapses in maintenance are decided by the diagnosis, so a diagnoser that calls a knowledge gap a slip (or an item-contract problem) keeps an LO in maintenance it should leave, and the reverse; kept outcomes are counted by reason.
A first review is one answer on one item: the miss rate has wide intervals until many assumptions have resolved.
Grader error: a grader that accepts a wrong answer can fast-track an LO or pass its check (Slice 1 E1 measures it).
Minutes are estimated from the learner's own answer latencies (or 3 minutes per item), not measured study time.

definitions.awaiting_diagnosis: An open assumption whose miss waits on its diagnosis (the decision waits, at most placement.rules.DIAGNOSIS_WAIT_DAYS from the miss's first diagnose job).
definitions.early_practice: A clean answer before first_review_due (explicit practice): recorded, never the check.
definitions.first_review: The first recorded answer on the LO from first_review_due on (an earlier miss can resolve it early).
definitions.full_marks_miss: A first review short of clean full marks, whatever the diagnosis decided (first_review_full_marks_miss_rate, the rate before the owner's 2026-10-12 decision): returned to learning, or kept by the diagnosis. An unassessed (PF-c) answer is no failure evidence and is not one.
definitions.ineligible_check_answer: A clean answer the independence rule rejected: neither pass nor miss.
definitions.items_avoided: Obligations never practised on an LO now in maintenance (its check passed).
definitions.items_deferred_pending_check: Obligations never practised on an LO still assumed (provisional).
definitions.items_deferred_then_learned: Obligations practised after the decision: learned anyway.
definitions.items_deferred_then_returned: Obligations on an LO back to learning: deferred, not saved.
definitions.items_used_as_checks: Items whose answer resolved an assumption's check.
definitions.kept_by_diagnosis: A first review short of clean full marks that kept the LO in maintenance: a slip, an item-contract or grader-interpretation problem, the interaction rather than knowledge, or an unassessed (PF-c) criterion.
definitions.learning_obligation: An active item on a decided LO not practised before its first decision, counted once whatever the number of decisions.
definitions.miss: A first review that returned the LO to learning (first_review_miss_rate): a miss the diagnosis attributed to a knowledge gap (causal_class learner_state on a valid_measurement attribution) or that left any part of it without a non-gap reading (no_gap_attributed), learner-side help (hints, priming, "don't know", assistance), or, when no diagnosis decided it (none landed within the wait, or the split's kill switch held it), any answer short of clean full marks (today's rule, reason no_diagnosis).
definitions.on_schedule: Resolved at or after the decision's first_review_due.
definitions.returned_by_learner: "I don't know this" before any answer on the LO.
